question: How often can a household visit the food pantry?
reference: Once every 7 days. In an emergency a case worker can approve an extra visit.

question: When is the Round Rock pantry open?
reference: Wednesday from 12pm to 6pm.

question: Who can get groceries delivered at home?
reference: Seniors over 65, people with disabilities and people without transportation, once every two weeks.

question: When are free hot meals served?
reference: Every weekday from 12pm to 1:30pm at the Austin location, with no registration needed.

question: How long can someone stay at the emergency shelter?
reference: Up to 30 days, and the stay can be extended by 30 days if the guest is working on their housing plan.

question: What time is check-in at Harbor House?
reference: From 5pm to 9pm every day.

question: Are pets allowed in the shelter?
reference: Small pets are allowed in family rooms only. Service animals are always allowed.

question: All the shelters are full and I have a 2 year old. What can you do?
reference: Families with children under 5 may receive a hotel voucher for up to 3 nights.

question: How much help can I get with past-due rent?
reference: One-time help of up to $1,500, paid directly to the landlord.

question: How often can a household get rental help?
reference: Once every 12 months.

question: Can you help with my electric bill?
reference: Yes, utility bills (electric and water) can be covered up to $300 to prevent a shut-off.

question: Does the legal clinic handle criminal cases?
reference: No. Criminal cases are referred to the public defender's office.

question: When is the walk-in legal clinic?
reference: Every Wednesday from 4pm to 8pm at 410 Oak Street, Austin.

question: My brother was detained by immigration. What should I do?
reference: Call (512) 555-0100 and ask for the urgent legal line. They try to connect you with an attorney within 24 hours.

question: How much will you pay toward a prescription?
reference: Up to 30 days of a prescription, up to $200.

question: Where and when is the free clinic?
reference: The Riverside Free Clinic at 300 Pine Street, San Marcos, on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 9am to 4pm.

question: How many free counseling sessions can I get?
reference: Up to 12 free sessions per person. Each session is 50 minutes.

question: When does the grief support group meet?
reference: Mondays from 6pm to 7:30pm at 410 Oak Street, Austin.

question: When do GED classes start?
reference: GED classes run in 12-week terms starting in January, May and September.

question: When can I sign up for free school supplies?
reference: Families can sign up from June 1 to July 31. Backpacks are given out every August.

question: Do I need to be a US citizen to get help?
reference: No. You do not need to be a US citizen and immigration status is never asked.

question: What documents do I need to bring?
reference: A photo ID and proof of address for most programs. A case worker can still help if you have no documents.
